audit.why: 50.00% over 138 games and the level chart already reads Skill / Malphite / Malphite / Skill / Skill / Malphite / Malphite, which is exactly the array on Malphite's own page — the mirror already agrees, so no side or rating was touched.
audit.corrected: No change to difficulty framing; the corrections below are mechanical.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are named but carry no numbers: 'once his first armor item and Unstoppable Force are both up', 'bait it before you commit E'.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100 at 1000 range. Ground Slam is a flat 7s. Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s, Shield of Durand 18s to 14s, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[2] and dosFull[0].d so 'bait the R' has a clock attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] states 'his stacked armor does nothing to your kit' and the early text implies armour is a wasted stat against you.
audit.why: Riot on Ground Slam: 'slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals MAGIC damage BASED ON HIS ARMOR.' Every armour item Malphite buys directly increases the magic damage he does to you — the one stat you cannot answer with MR alone.
audit.corrected: Armour is not a dead stat here; it powers a flat-7-second magic nuke. Written into whys[3], early and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings claim Hero's Entrance applies a taunt: 'Hero's Entrance taunt' and "Hero's Entrance's landing taunt".
audit.why: Riot: 'After a delay Galio smashes down location, KNOCKING UP nearby enemies.' Galio's ultimate knocks up and shields — the taunt belongs to Shield of Durand alone.
audit.corrected: Corrected to the landing knockup in spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield is never mentioned in either layer even though it decides whether your poke does anything.
audit.why: Riot: 'Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' A single poke that only pops the shield is refunded to him for free.
audit.corrected: Strip Granite Shield with the Winds of War tornado, then commit inside the same window — never poke once and walk away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Loading line ends 'Anti-heal if he sustains'.
audit.why: No ability in Malphite's kit carries a heal flag and none of Riot's descriptions mention healing. Granite Shield is a recharging shield, not sustain, so Grievous Wounds does nothing here.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Granite Shield strip rule.

edits.before: You own the short trades on his cooldowns, and every point of his Q-W magic damage gets blanked and amplifies your reduction while his stacked armor does nothing to your kit.
edits.after: You own the short trades on his cooldowns, but his armour is not a dead stat — Ground Slam is a flat 7s and Riot scales its MAGIC damage off the armour he stacks.

edits.before: Malphite's early chip is mostly magic damage - his Q slow and his empowered W auto poke you, and that is exactly what Shield of Durand wants to eat. Charge W as he winds up to poke so the magic-amplified reduction blanks it, then release the taunt and trade back. Don't burn mana shoving a flat wave; you out-range him with Winds of War and your Colossal Smash empowered auto already wins the level-1 chip. He has no kill threat here against your shield - only attrition - so play patient and let his poke refill your trades.
edits.after: Malphite's early chip is mostly magic damage - his Q slow and his empowered W auto poke you, and that is exactly what Shield of Durand wants to eat. Charge W as he winds up to poke so the magic-amplified reduction blanks it, then release the taunt and trade back. Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges after a few seconds untouched, so strip it with the Winds of War tornado and commit inside that window rather than poking once and walking away. You out-range him already; play patient.

edits.before: Once his first armor item (Sunfire/Iceborn) and Unstoppable Force are both up, his R is the one window that flips a trade your W was winning - bait it before you commit E.
edits.after: Once his first armor item and Unstoppable Force (130s at rank 1, 1000 range) are both up, his R is the one window that flips a trade your W was winning - bait it before you commit E.

edits.before: His R-flank onto your carries outweighs lane now; hold Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance taunt as the two answers that blank his unstoppable engage.
edits.after: His R-flank onto your carries outweighs lane now; Shield of Durand's taunt and the Hero's Entrance landing knockup are the two answers you hold for his engage.

edits.before: Lane reads even because Malphite scales into an unstoppable teamfight, not because he beats you in a box - he never does, since you're all magic damage into his armor. His R-engage onto your carries is the real threat now, so your role flips from laner to anti-engage: Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance's landing taunt are your two answers to his flank. Shove and use Hero's Entrance to be everywhere; your global presence is the edge, not raw 1v1 dominance. Build for the teamfight and position to taunt his all-in the instant his R lands.
edits.after: Lane reads even because Malphite scales into an unstoppable teamfight, not because he beats you in a box - his armour blunts nothing you throw, though it does feed his own Ground Slam every seven seconds. His R-engage onto your carries is the real threat now, so your role flips from laner to anti-engage: Shield of Durand's taunt and the Hero's Entrance landing knockup are your two answers to his flank. Shove and drop your ult on an ally up to 4000 units away; that presence is the edge, not raw 1v1 dominance in a lane neither of you closes.

edits.before: He scales into an unstoppable R-flank onto your backline; the lane edge becomes your R-presence and the W/R taunts that answer his engage, not 1v1 dominance.
edits.after: He scales into an R-flank onto your backline; the lane edge becomes your ult presence and the W taunt plus the landing knockup that answer his engage.

edits.after: - Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1, 100s maxed, from 1000 range — the one tool that flips your trade. - Ground Slam: a flat 7s, and its magic damage scales off his armour. - Seismic Shard: a flat 8s. - Your W: 18s. - Your E: 11s to 7s.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Malphite wins by landing Unstoppable Force, punishing your E commit, and out-trading the windows your shield is down.
edits.after: Malphite wins by landing Unstoppable Force from 1000, recharging Granite Shield between your pokes, and out-trading a spent W.

notes: Two real errors. First, whys[3] told the player Malphite's stacked armour 'does nothing to your kit' — Riot's own text for Ground Slam is 'deals MAGIC damage based on his Armor', so every armour item he buys raises the damage he does to Galio, on a flat 7-second cooldown. Second, two strings credit Hero's Entrance with a taunt; Riot's description is a landing KNOCKUP, and the taunt belongs to Shield of Durand only. Also added Granite Shield, which was absent from both layers despite being the reason single pokes accomplish nothing. UNVERIFIED, left in place rather than asserted or removed: three strings describe Unstoppable Force as 'unstoppable' engage that a taunt can 'blank'. Malphite's kit carries no unstoppable flag and Riot's text does not mention displacement immunity, so I could not confirm or refute whether Galio's taunt actually interrupts it. Consistent with the mirror at audits/top/malphite__galio.json, which noted the same limitation from the other side and rated the knockup-interrupts-W claim Medium.
